name: CZWF Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Iron Bull entered Monday Night Adrenaline (11-21) as reigning champion and lost the belt to the Undertaker in a Double Tables Match — the earliest documented state of this title in the held record, sent through a table to lose it. The fed's own home page recap frames the two men's rivalry as ongoing ("a seesaw gone wrong"), and no further title change survives; the Undertaker's win is the held record's last-attested state of the belt.

name: CZWF Women's Championship
epitaph: Trish Stratus entered Monday Night Adrenaline (11-21) as reigning champion and tapped out to Chyna's chicken wing after a chair shot opened the match's closing stretch — the held record's last-attested state of this title, with no start date preserved for Stratus's own reign.

name: CZWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Rey Mysterio entered Monday Night Adrenaline (11-21) as reigning champion and tapped out to "Super Crazy" AJ Warner's elbow submission hold — the held record's last-attested state of this title, with no start date preserved for Mysterio's own reign.

name: CZWF Hardcore Championship
epitaph: "Super Crazy" AJ Warner is named the reigning CZWF Hardcore Champion on the fed's own undated Champions page — the belt's own last-attested holder in the held record, alongside a CZWF Intercontinental Championship he won the same night on Monday Night Adrenaline (11-21).

name: CZWF Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Killer92 is named the reigning CZWF Cruiserweight Champion on the fed's own undated Champions page — the belt's own last-attested holder in the held record.

name: CZWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Hippies are named the reigning CZWF Tag Team Champions on the fed's own undated Champions page — the belt's own last-attested holders in the held record; no member roster survives.

name: CZWF X-Division Championship
epitaph: John Cena is named the reigning CZWF X-Division Champion on the fed's own undated Champions page. Andre the Giant earned a No. 1 contendership over Randy Orton on Monday Night Adrenaline (11-21), and the fed's own home page recap previews a still-pending challenge — no result for it survives in the held record.

name: CZWF X Division Tag Team Championship
epitaph: the Chain Gang are named the reigning CZWF X Division Tag Team Champions on the fed's own undated Champions page — the belt's own last-attested holders in the held record; no member roster survives.
